name: Repo health check
description: Run the lint gate first and only wake the agent when the check fails.

tasks.title: Nightly lint gate
tasks.description: Cheap script gate: a clean lint run skips the agent entirely.
tasks.prompt:
The scheduled lint gate failed. Fix the reported problems.

Workspace contract: this run owns the runs/<runId>/ directory (run.json, prompt.md, output.md, logs/ and tmp/); the lint log is written to its logs/ area (and $SCHEDULED_TASK_TMP_DIR). Keep long-lived notes, such as recurring lint offenders or a suppression allow-list, in $SCHEDULED_TASK_STATE_DIR so the next run can reuse them; the task tmp/ directory is wiped at the start of every run, so never keep anything you need across runs there. Only write inside $SCHEDULED_TASK_DIR and the project directory.

1. Read the lint output.
2. Fix every reported problem (do not disable rules to make the gate pass).
3. Re-run the lint command locally and append what you changed to $SCHEDULED_TASK_STATE_DIR/notes.md.
tasks.command: if npm run lint --silent >"$SCHEDULED_TASK_TMP_DIR/lint.log" 2>&1; then printf '%s' '{"skip":true,"reason":"lint clean"}'; else printf '%s' '{"prompt":"The scheduled lint gate failed. Read the run log, fix the reported problems, and keep long-lived notes in the task state directory (SCHEDULED_TASK_STATE_DIR) before finishing."}'; fi
